headline: Mod installs and updates reach Development, alongside graphics, sound and control fixes
summary: Development builds gain a signed mod index, dependency installation, automatic updates with rollback and setup sharing (#161). That launcher work has not yet been run on Windows, macOS or Android. Players also get diagonal stick movement fixes, fewer Windows sound gaps and corrected underwater visibility on Pokitaru; Vulkan becomes the default renderer (#168, #188, #194). The source import in #160 accounts for 111,618 of the day’s 138,618 added lines.
highlights: Steam library setup adds pictures; tested on Linux, it still needs Windows and macOS checks and refuses Flatpak Steam (#184). Mod hub links and listing badges also land (#182).
Android Enhanced graphics uses ASR or no upscaler, with cheaper Vulkan passes; its drawer gains texture upscaling, motion blur, colour correction and reset controls (#165, #183).
Windows fixes restore Orxon’s electric barrier strands and Batalia explosion colours, and prevent an animated shadow-pass crash (#171, #178, #186).

Contributors gain an Object Viewer, Freecam and culling inspection; experimental light editing requires a build flag that defaults off (#195, #196). Crash reports gain symbols and activity trails (#175, #193).
Mod SDK 1.11.0 adds per-mod storage and the current save slot (#172). Fullscreen first start, overlay scaling and Steam Controller support without Steam also land (#177).

Audio replacement remains an open proposal (#164). Cross-region co-op (#166) and the USA v1.01 Going Commando port (#191) remain unmerged drafts; the latter runs but is not playable, with ship controls incomplete and most menus untested.
